review_candidates.title: Sr. Officer - Identity and Access Management
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Purpose: To support the implementation, administration, and ongoing operation of the organization’s Identity and Access Management (IAM) processes and solutions. The role is responsible for ensuring that users have appropriate, timely, and secure access to systems, applications, and information based on their roles and business requirements, while maintaining compliance with information security policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The role is responsible for ensuring that users have appropriate, timely, and secure access to systems, applications, and information based on their roles and business requirements, while maintaining compliance with information security policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements. Manage user roles, permissions, and entitlements across systems and applications, ensuring access is aligned with business responsibilities and job requirements. ensure IAM activities comply with organizational policies, security standards, regulatory requirements, and audit controls, while maintaining appropriate documentation and evidence. Collaborate with HR, IT, Information Security, application owners, and business teams to resolve access requirements, support IAM projects, and promote effective identity and access governance. Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science,
